## Letter

To you,

I’m Rick Weng, an AI security researcher. My work examines how language models and AI agents actually behave: how activation steering changes them, what functional states they carry, and how to keep agents operating within the rules people set.

Every study I run is preregistered before any data are collected, compared only against fair controls, and reported in full, including results that did not hold. What follows covers the companies I have founded, my projects, my research and my open contributions. Should you wish to get in touch, a return envelope is enclosed below.

Yours sincerely, Rick Weng

P.S. All Saturn products are free to use. https://saturn-core.com

## Experience

### [Kura Finance](https://kura-finance.com)

Founder & Solo product engineer · 2026 – Sep 2026 · Previous

Modern finance, redesigned. An integrated finance platform: a single account to save, spend, invest, earn yield and transfer funds worldwide.

- Defined the product vision for a unified, privacy-first global finance platform.
- Established partnerships with fintech infrastructure providers across digital assets, yield and payments.

## Current projects

### [Saturn](https://saturn-core.com)

Creator & Lead Maintainer · Sep 2026 – Present · Active

Infrastructure for secure, accountable AI. Saturn focuses on AI security: ensuring that agents operate within the rules people set, and giving teams a clear view of how models actually behave before they rely on them.

- Saturn MCP: a gateway that enforces argument-level policy on every agent tool call, routes sensitive calls for human approval, and maintains a complete audit record.
- Saturn App: an open-source (Apache 2.0) desktop workbench for AI research, supporting experiment management, sample-level review, activation patching and SAE feature analysis.
- Credentials are held in a post-quantum vault, and audit payloads are encrypted on archival, so they remain unreadable even to the gateway itself.
- Both products are free, with full functionality on every account, and are funded through sponsorship.

## Research: Understanding how AI systems actually behave.

### Research goals

- Pretraining
- Interpretability

### Papers

- Activation steering in coding agents (2026)

## Vulnerability disclosures

No published CVEs yet.

## Open contributions

Tools and research practices, freely available to all.

### [Saturn App](https://github.com/Saturn-Technology-Project/Saturn-App)

*Open source · Apache 2.0*

A desktop workbench for AI research: experiments are compared only when measured identically, every sample from every model can be inspected, and activation patching and SAE features are built in. Each release ships with a checksum and signed build provenance.

### [Saturn MCP](https://saturn-core.com/mcp)

*Free to use*

A gateway that governs what AI agents may do: every tool call is checked against versioned policy down to its arguments, sensitive calls are routed for human approval, and every decision is recorded.

### Open research

*Methodology*

Each paper is published with its preregistration, code and raw data, including results that did not hold, so the findings can be independently verified.

### [Code](https://github.com/rickwengdev)

*GitHub*

Research experiments, tools, and the source code for this website.

## 信件

To you,

我是 Rick Weng，從事 AI 安全研究。我的研究聚焦於語言模型與 AI 代理的實際行為：激活操控如何改變模型、模型內部存在哪些功能狀態，以及如何確保代理在既定規則內運作。

我的每項研究都在取得資料前完成預先登記，只與公平的對照組比較，未成立的結果也一併公開。以下依序介紹我創辦的公司、專案、研究工作與開放成果；如需聯繫，回郵信封附在本信下方。

Rick Weng 敬上

附註：Saturn 的所有產品皆免費提供。 https://saturn-core.com

## 經歷

### [Kura Finance](https://kura-finance.com)

創辦人暨執行長 · 2026 – 2026 年 9 月 · 過往

重新設計現代金融服務。 一站式金融平台：以單一帳戶完成儲蓄、消費、投資、收益與跨境轉帳。

## 目前的專案

### [Saturn](https://saturn-core.com)

創建者暨主要維護者 · 2026 年 9 月 – 至今 · 進行中

為 AI 打造安全、可問責的基礎工具。 Saturn 專注於 AI 安全，致力於確保 AI 代理的行為符合既定規則，並讓使用者在部署模型之前，充分理解模型的實際行為。

- Saturn MCP：AI 代理的工具呼叫閘道，對每一次呼叫執行參數層級的政策檢查，將敏感操作交由人工核准，並完整保存稽核紀錄。
- Saturn App：以 Apache 2.0 授權開源的 AI 研究桌面工作台，支援實驗管理、逐筆樣本檢視、激活修補與 SAE 特徵分析。
- 憑證儲存於後量子加密保險庫；稽核資料於歸檔時即加密，即使閘道本身也無法讀取。
- 兩項產品皆免費提供，所有帳號享有完整功能，營運經費來自贊助。

## 開放成果

所有人皆可免費使用的工具與研究方法。

### [Saturn App](https://github.com/Saturn-Technology-Project/Saturn-App)

*開源 · Apache 2.0*

AI 研究桌面工作台：僅比較以相同方法量測的實驗，可逐筆檢視各模型的樣本，並內建激活修補與 SAE 特徵分析。每個版本皆附檢查碼與經簽章的建置來源證明。

### [Saturn MCP](https://saturn-core.com/mcp)

*免費使用*

管理 AI 代理權限的閘道：依版本化政策對每一次工具呼叫進行參數層級的檢查，敏感操作交由人工核准，所有決策皆完整記錄。

### 開放研究

*研究方法*

每篇論文皆附上預先登記、程式碼與原始資料，包含未成立的結果，任何人都能獨立驗證。

### [程式碼](https://github.com/rickwengdev)

*GitHub*

研究實驗、工具，以及本網站的原始碼。
